optional; serialised values are stable so the cache helper can hash them.

SgdbAsset.description:
Normalised asset record used for grids, heroes, logos, and icons. The four
SGDB asset endpoints return the same shape with slightly different valid
styles/dimensions/mimes; we keep them as one struct and let the response
stream them through unchanged.

SgdbAssetFilterQuery.description:
Optional filter knobs forwarded to SGDB on every asset endpoint.
Comma-separated string fields accept whatever values SGDB accepts; the
proxy does not pre-validate the enum values, so future SGDB additions
flow through without a code change.

SgdbGame.description:
Game record returned by `/games/id/{id}`, `/games/{platform}/{id}`, and the
search autocomplete endpoint. Field set is small but stable.

SgdbTriState.description:
Tri-state filter SGDB accepts on `nsfw`, `humor`, and `epilepsy` query
params. Encoded as `"true"`, `"false"`, or `"any"` on the wire.

providerId.description: The ID of the game, company, or platform on the metadata provider.

source.description: Origin of an externally-submitted suggestion (e.g. truncated User-Agent), null for user-submitted ones.

updatedAt.description: When the suggestion was last updated.

UpdateUserPermissionsRequest.description: Request to update a user's permissions.

id.description: ID of the entity matched (game, platform or company).
